title: How to Handle a Boss Who Takes Credit for Your Work
script: A boss who takes credit for your work is playing a power game, not an oversight. The mistake most people make: they stay silent, seethe quietly, and then blow up later — which destroys the relationship and their reputation. The smart play: document everything in writing, from day one. A Slack message, an email, a shared doc. When your boss presents your work in a meeting, the paper trail speaks for you. Then, in private: 'Hey, I noticed my analysis on X was presented — just wanted to make sure you have full context on my contributions for future reviews.' Calm. Factual. Undeniable.
